feature: Button-only source word selection with preview, extension, cancellation and save
checks: Combining marks and Hebrew use complete source words in source order
Repeated words retain distinct source offsets
Cancel leaves state unchanged; save captures the exact source range
Reverse extension spans paragraphs without changing state before save
Word-menu scrolling reaches entry 25 without moving the reading anchor
Reading pixels remain unchanged after unhighlighted capture
Stale page before pick or save reports an error without inserting a clipping
Existing touch selection and all shared UI regressions pass
limits: Native window input and physical button input for this workflow are not qualified.
Dense-page memory use, synchronous scanning latency, the 1,024-entry rejection and split-page word behavior are not separately tested here.
Word labels truncate at 32 Unicode scalar values and may split a combining sequence; source ranges preserve whole words.
Cross-page extension and draggable or shrinkable handles remain unfinished.
This incremental monochrome build does not refresh clean-build reproducibility or grayscale evidence. No firmware was flashed.
